scope: Consistency of final report conclusions with sealed aggregate/run-level scores, measurements and native audit. No re-adjudication or model invocation.

confirmed_native_audit.scope_note: These counts were checked against the sealed audit and its per-run booleans, not re-derived from raw wire content in this review.

conclusion_checks.reason: The report states no additional known-root-cause detection or delivery benefit, records lower team evidence counts and limits the conclusion to the current small closed-packet suite.
The report labels the four pairs observational, discloses random generation/cache/request differences and explicitly says 46.9% is not acceleration with all quality unchanged.

conclusion_checks.check: Runtime timing not full verified-delivery endpoint
conclusion_checks.reason: The timer boundary and excluded preparation, serialization, audit and scoring stages are explicit; UI/tool-validation/product end-to-end time is not claimed.
Same output ceilings are distinguished from actual token, cache, request, cost and time use; the fixed A+ profile is not equated with every possible single-agent strategy.

The recommendation keeps the single-agent product baseline and existing research CLI modes, does not promote this profile to default/recommended production collaboration, and lists remaining integration/validation work.
Injected candidates, closed preselected packets, non-human independent adjudication, imperfect blinding, task versus repeat units, evidence gaps and sample-size limits are stated.

measurement_consistency: The final report retains the previously verified 46.9% ratio-of-total runtime reduction, 50.83 seconds mean pair saving and about +5.9% paired cost. Known/unknown ledger boundaries and totals agree with the prior final-measurement-review.
adoption_recommendation_consistency: Retain the complete single-agent baseline and reusable experimental collaboration entry points. Do not market this fixed profile as a demonstrated quality improvement. This is supported by the sealed results without implying universal multi-agent uselessness or architecture equivalence.
limitations: This review checks report-to-evidence consistency and does not independently reopen individual finding judgments.
The reviewer authored the benchmark; final causal adjudication was performed and sealed by a different agent.
No population-level equivalence, significance, natural-defect prevalence or production readiness follows from these results.
